title: Transport coefficient naturality through edge compatibility
statement: For any scheme morphism f:X -> Y and coefficient morphism phi:N -> f_*F, functions E from module cohomology to Ext cohomology on Y and E prime for F on X that respect phi and the identity edge map also respect the h-map of phi. No equivalence hypothesis is required. The two coefficient factorizations [new-module-cohomology-coefficient-factor] [new-module-cohomology-ext-coefficient-factor] prove this compatibility.

source.place: Coefficient functoriality, specialized to an identity coefficient map.

proof.text: Factor the module map through the identity edge map. Apply its given compatibility, then the given source coefficient naturality. The Ext coefficient factorization supplies the last equality. Combine the four equalities by congrArg and transitivity.

theorem moduleCohomology_transport_coefficient
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (N : Y.Modules) (F : X.Modules)
    (φ : N ⟶ (pushforward f).obj F) (p : ℕ)
    (E : ∀ M : Y.Modules,
      (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace p).obj M → H (X := Y) M p)
    (E' : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p).obj F → H (X := X) F p)
    (hnat : ∀ x, E ((pushforward f).obj F)
      (((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace p).map φ).hom x) =
        H.map (X := Y) φ p (E N x))
    (hedge : ∀ x, E' (moduleCohomologyEdgeMap f F p x) =
      Sheaf.H.map (coeff (X := X) (Y := Y) (M := (pushforward f).obj F) (N := F)
        f (𝟙 ((pushforward f).obj F))) p
        (Sheaf.H.mapFunctor (invImage f) (constIso f).symm
          ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf Y.ringCatSheaf).obj ((pushforward f).obj F)) p
          (E ((pushforward f).obj F) x)))
    (x : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace p).obj N) :
    E' (moduleCohomologyFMap (X := X) (Y := Y) (G := N) (F := F) f φ p x) =
      Sheaf.H.map (coeff (X := X) (Y := Y) (M := N) (N := F) f φ) p
        (Sheaf.H.mapFunctor (invImage f) (constIso f).symm
          ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf Y.ringCatSheaf).obj N) p (E N x))
